verdict.rationale: Databricks is a managed cloud SaaS platform; nothing in the evidence indicates an option to self-host the core product on one's own infrastructure — all docs point to workspaces, pricing, and cloud-based deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP hosted). Since the platform could conceivably offer an on-prem/self-managed edition (as some data platforms do) but none is documented, this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
